title: Inventory screen rebuilt on the layout: hotbar row plus 4 rows, coin and ammo columns, saved trash, sort and quick-stack buttons, panel host
player_outcome:
Opening the inventory looks like Terraria:
- The hotbar becomes row 1 of a 10×5 grid in the same spot.
- Coin and ammo columns sit to its right, with the trash can under them.
- Sort Inventory and Quick Stack to Nearby Chests buttons sit beside them.
- Chests, shops and services appear under the grid, crafting bottom-left, and equipment on the right under the minimap.
- Nothing covers anything else, and opening a chest no longer hitches.
design:
Split game/UI/InventoryScreen.cs:
- InventoryScreen.cs: open/close, gate, _Process distance close.
- InventoryScreen.Layout.cs: build the containers and apply the UiLayout rects on resize or panel change.
- InventoryScreen.Clicks.cs: map (view, SlotRef) to GameWorld.ClickSlot with the right SlotContext; play grab, equip or open sounds by outcome; mark the crafting panel dirty.
Backpack: a 10-column GridContainer in the Inventory rect, whose origin equals the HUD hotbar's. Slots 0–9 use SlotKind.HotbarSelected for the selected one. Slot size = 52 · SlotScale.

New game/UI/Inventory/CoinAmmoColumns.cs:
- Two VBoxes of 4 small slots (SlotKind.Coin and Ammo, empty hints slot_coin and slot_ammo) under the captions 'Coins' and 'Ammo'.
- A trash slot (SlotKind.Trash, EmptyHint trash) under the ammo column.
- Two 26 px TextureButtons: sort → InventoryOps.Sort(backpack, 10, 50); quick_stack → GameWorld.QuickStackNearby. Both have tooltips.
- Remove the `_coins` text label and the UI-owned `_trash`.

Panel host: a Control in the Panel rect with `ShowPanel(Control panel, UiPanel kind)` and `ClosePanel()`. The existing chest grid moves into it, with 40 pooled slot views rebound on open instead of recreated (today InventoryScreen.cs:171,181 QueueFree and re-create them). ChestPanel (P2-17), ShopPanel (P2-27) and ServicePanel (P2-28) plug in here.

Crafting host: the CraftingPanel is sized by the Crafting rect (remove the hard-coded Initialize position at InventoryScreen.cs:93). Equipment host: the current armor and accessory columns move into the Equipment rect until P2-16 replaces them.
The WorldClickCatcher from P2-11 is the root's first child; CursorItemLayer (P2-10) draws the cursor.
On close: stow the cursor (existing), stow the Service slot, close the panel. The HUD hotbar is hidden and the item name reads 'Inventory' while open.
files_modify: game/UI/InventoryScreen.cs — split; layout-driven; pooled chest slots; panel host
game/UI/Hud.cs — hide the hotbar while the inventory is open
files_add: game/UI/Inventory/CoinAmmoColumns.cs — coins, ammo, trash, sort and quick-stack buttons
tests:
ui.cmds:
- `ui inventory` / `assert ui.overlaps == 0`.
- `give copper_coin 250` / `assert inv.silver_coin == 2`.
- `invclick backpack 4 left ctrl` / `assert inv.trash >= 1`.
- `ui sort` / `assert errors == 0` / `ui close`.
verification: Lavapipe at 1024×600 (UI scale 1) and 1920×1080: the inventory grid exactly covers the hotbar spot; coin and ammo columns, trash, crafting and equipment are all visible and apart
risks: Largest UI refactor in the phase. Land it before P2-16, P2-17, P2-18, P2-27 and P2-28, which all plug into it.
